error instance is returned in the tuple pair for the receiver that raised the error.

The tracebacks are present on the ``__traceback__`` attribute of the errors

Exceptions raised by receivers are also logged using the ``django.dispatch.dispatcher``
logger, so they will appear in your error handling tools (e.g. Sentry). Any
*expected* exceptions should be caught with a try/except in the receiver function.
